string.name: entry_tagline
string.value: Open Source License Scanner & Viewer for HarmonyOS ArkTS Projects

string.name: entry_feature_scan_title
string.value: Generate License Metadata at Build Time

string.name: entry_feature_scan_desc
string.value: A Hvigor plugin walks the project's OHPM dependencies at build time, generates license metadata, and bundles it into the app package. No filesystem permission is required at runtime.

string.name: entry_feature_ui_desc
string.value: Ready-to-use license list and detail pages built with ArkUI and the UI Design Kit.

string.name: entry_feature_skill_desc
string.value:
Provides an Agent Skill to help AI agents quickly integrate OSSLibraries into your HarmonyOS ArkTS project.
$ npx skills add composable-tu/osslibraries
